notes.title: Share your learnings
notes.content:
Now, you can share your code with other friends:

In the free play stage, click the "Browser" button and click the corresponding game type to enter the sharing page of that type:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41827211/c99296ffc1b15ad9f7e0e905b678b400d7b26ac3.png[/img]

[i]Tips# This project is a channel for communication and sharing between users. All codes are provided by users. For unfamiliar codes, do not copy and paste them directly. Avoid being attacked by malicious code. [/i]
